utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Monday the twentieth. Can you all hear me, or am I doing the Teams mime again?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: We can hear you. Probably over the heating in the portakabin as well. July and it's like a drying cupboard in here.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Lovely. We've finally got summer and you're making your own.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, luxury accommodation. Not reporting a job, before anyone opens anything.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: There's a birthday cake in the office, incidentally. No idea whose birthday, but that hasn't stopped anyone.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Between that and the charity bake sale on Friday, we're doing well for cake. Friday's brownies were ridiculously good.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: I got the empty tin. Excellent timing, as usual.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Right, before this becomes a catering review. What's already finished?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah so, finished the repair on the pick and place on two last night. That's done.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Properly finished, not the nearly-finished version?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Properly. Nothing left on that repair. You can stop looking at me like that.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: And I tested the line one yesterday and it's all fine now. That's completed as well.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Good. That was the one hanging around in the handover, wasn't it?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: That's the one. Old news now, thankfully.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Just an observation from nights: noticed the Line 2 Pick and Place Robot was running a bit warm on nights but it settled down.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Settled during the run, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah. Not asking for another job on it, just passing on what was in the shift notes.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Similar sort of thing, I saw the pressure on the line 1 mould temp dip for a few minutes, it came back on its own.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Sorry, you clipped there. It came back without anyone touching it?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Without anyone touching it, yeah. Only an observation, no outstanding action from that.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Right, both observations, not new work. Anything still blocked?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: I can't get to the Main Outfeed Conveyor until production gives us a window. Same blocker as before.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: There's no confirmed window in the plan. That's still blocked, not something we're committing to today.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Exactly. Can't magic an empty conveyor out of a full one.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Okay. Separate to that, we need to schedule downtime for the GT1 fuel valve with production. Fairly important, that one.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: I'll schedule downtime for the GT1 fuel valve with production. Yeah, agreed, fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: That's arranging the downtime, just so we're clear, rather than saying the valve work itself is booked?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Exactly. I'll agree the downtime with production; I'm not claiming we've already got a slot.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Thanks, Priya. That's yours.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: And Priya, can you inspect the GT2 inlet valve for leaks next Tuesday? Whenever you get a chance, that level of priority.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll inspect the GT2 inlet valve for leaks next Tuesday.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Sorry, talked over the end there. GT2, not the GT1 fuel valve?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: GT2 inlet valve for the leak inspection, next Tuesday. GT1 fuel valve is the downtime discussion. Two separate things.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: That's it. And the inspection is whenever you get a chance, not a drop-everything job.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: While we're on the valve bits, I'll recalibrate the sensors on the Boiler Safety Relief Valve.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: What timing are you putting against that, Grace?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: By the 28th. It's a whenever you get a chance one, within that deadline.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Okay, Grace has the sensor recalibration on the Boiler Safety Relief Valve, by the 28th.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: The sensors, yeah? Not changing the valve set pressure. Just making sure I've heard it properly.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, the sensors only. Recalibration, not a change to the valve setting.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: And I'll update the risk assessment for work on the Boiler Safety Relief Valve at half two. That's fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Sorry, at half two, rather than sometime this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: At half two, yes. The risk assessment update. Separate from the sensor recalibration deadline.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Got you, Grace. Fairly important, risk assessment at half two.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: There's also the pressure drop on the main water valve. Not the little mould temp dip we mentioned earlier; this is separate and does need investigating.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: I'll investigate the pressure drop on the main water valve. I'll drop everything for that one.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Right, Grace Liu taking the main water valve pressure-drop investigation. Drop everything for that one, agreed.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yes, that's mine. That goes ahead of the other bits.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Okay, so the pressure-drop investigation is the urgent one. The sensor recalibration hasn't suddenly become the same priority.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Correct. Sensors are still whenever you get a chance, by the 28th. Different urgency entirely.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: And just to avoid crossed wires on mine, the GT1 fuel valve downtime still needs agreeing with production. No slot promised in this call.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, understood. Arranging it, not announcing an outage.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: And none of that changes the Main Outfeed Conveyor situation.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: No. Still blocked by the production window. Nothing new agreed on that.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Nothing else from me. My repair's finished; I'm not sneaking another one onto the end.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Lovely. Quick check of what we've actually agreed. Priya?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: I'll schedule downtime for the GT1 fuel valve with production, fairly important. And I'll inspect the GT2 inlet valve for leaks next Tuesday, whenever I get a chance.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yep. Grace?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: I'll investigate the pressure drop on the main water valve, drop everything for that one. I'll update the risk assessment for work on the Boiler Safety Relief Valve at half two, fairly important. And I'll recalibrate the sensors on the Boiler Safety Relief Valve by the 28th, whenever I get a chance.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: That matches what I've got. Finished work and observations kept separate, conveyor still blocked.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good stuff. I'm slowly becoming part of this portakabin, so that's quite enough sitting here.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Right, we'll leave it there. Cheers, everyone.
